## Description {#details}

<p>===------------------------------------------------------------------—===//</p>


<p>This pass moves instructions close to the definition of its operands to shrink live range of the def instruction. The code motion is limited within the basic block. The moved instruction should have 1 def, and more than one uses, all of which are the only use of the def.</p>


<p>===------------------------------------------------------------------—===//</p>

<p>Returns <span class="doxyComputerOutput">New</span> if it's dominated by <span class="doxyComputerOutput">Old</span>, otherwise return <span class="doxyComputerOutput">Old</span>.</p>


<p><span class="doxyComputerOutput">M</span> maintains a map from instruction to its dominating order that satisfies M[A] &gt; M[B] guarantees that A is dominated by B. If <span class="doxyComputerOutput">New</span> is not in <span class="doxyComputerOutput">M</span>, return <span class="doxyComputerOutput">Old</span>. Otherwise if <span class="doxyComputerOutput">Old</span> is null, return <span class="doxyComputerOutput">New</span>.</p>
